verdict.rationale: Justworks documents a Xero integration. You connect your Xero account, map each pay type to Chart of Accounts accounts, and can override mappings by department, office or employee. A sync-method option lets payroll invoices sync automatically the day after processing. Missing for 10: any evidence of a QuickBooks integration, explicit confirmation that the synced records are journal entries (the docs say 'invoices'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
